scenarios.title: Wildfire Watch (Earth)
scenarios.goal: Detect emerging wildfires worldwide early with <= 1 km thermal resolution and <= 12 h revisit within a $150M budget.
scenarios.educationalNote: At least three distinct architectures can pass: (1) Balanced SSO satellite, (2) Continuous GEO observatory, or (3) Dual low-cost LEO satellites.

scenarios.title: Ice Hunter (Moon)
scenarios.goal: Map water-ice deposits inside Permanently Shadowed Regions (PSRs) at both lunar poles to support Artemis habitats.
scenarios.educationalNote: No magnetic field means magnetorquers don't work on the Moon—pack reaction wheels and choose a high-inclination polar or frozen orbit.

scenarios.title: Dust Storm Tracker (Mars)
scenarios.goal: Monitor planet-encircling dust storms across Mars over a 2-year mission.
scenarios.educationalNote: Future expansion scenario demonstrating deep-space latency and reduced solar irradiance (~43% of Earth) at 1.52 AU.

scenarios.title: Lunar Orbit and Return (Crewed Prototype)
scenarios.goal: Assemble an Orion-class crew spacecraft and launch vehicle capable of carrying 4 astronauts around the Moon and safely home.
scenarios.educationalNote: Crewed lunar prototype showcasing life-support consumables, radiation storm shelters, and trans-lunar injection payload limits.
